name: Attribute modifiers
order: No formula located; do not evaluate a guessed floor((score-10)/2).

name: Maximum wounds
inputs: class Hit Die, resolved Con modifier at acquisition, chosen die roll/fixed gain, feature contributions
order: Level 1: die maximum + Con; later d6/d8/d10/d12 fixed 4/5/6/7 or chosen roll + Con. Accumulate recorded gains, then only resolved feature policies. Retroactivity/floor needs ruling.

name: Current wounds
inputs: owned current HP, accepted damage/healing event, calculated maximum
order: No mutation during recalculation. At 0 apply unconscious/death procedure. Max changes, healing overflow and negative healing require explicit policy.

name: Defence / AC
inputs: one source armour expression, resolved Dex, shield, applicable cover and effects
order: Explicit base+Dex rows: base+min(Dex,cap) when cap stated; negative Dex is retained. Shield +2. Cover applies only to crossing attack. Unarmoured/ambiguous bases/stacking remain blocked.

name: Movement
inputs: species base in ft, source modifiers, conditions, runtime mode
order: Use species base; apply explicitly supported changes. Grappled: zero and cannot benefit from speed bonuses. Exhaustion uses cumulative levels; conflicting multiplication order unresolved.

name: Initiative
inputs: resolved Dex modifier, applicable feature modifiers
order: d20 + Dex modifier + source-defined resolved bonuses. Squad Drill requires its chosen ally/context.

name: Attack modifiers
inputs: relevant resolved ability, proficiency entitlement, level, context
order: Ability + proficiency once if proficient, then only applicable approved modifiers. Finesse permits Str/Dex; no universal weapon ability guessed.

name: Damage modifiers
order: No complete personal weapon default ability rule located. Mounted attack-roll damage adds Dex once; mounted area adds none. Offhand Light melee excludes positive ability unless feature.

name: Skill bonuses
inputs: skill or GM-chosen ability, resolved modifier, entitlement, level
order: Ability modifier + PB if proficient. Explicit GM ability reassignment is context, not content rewrite.

name: Saving throws
inputs: resolved relevant ability, granted save proficiency, level
order: Ability modifier + PB only if save proficiency is granted.

name: Proficiency
order: 1–4:2;5–8:3;9–12:4;13–16:5;17–20:6. Use table thresholds; no extrapolation.

name: Expertise
order: Referenced but not defined.

name: Critical thresholds
inputs: natural retained attack face, weapon/feature scope
order: Ordinary natural20; only apply explicit scoped expanded ranges. Unconscious within5ft has special hit rule. No automatic-success convention inferred.

name: Critical damage
inputs: ordinary attack damage dice/components and flat modifiers
order: Double ordinary attack damage dice counts; flat modifiers once; then explicit critical extra dice. Multi-die selection unresolved for personal properties, mounted first listed die explicit.
stackingCapsFloors: Technical dice limits are not game caps

name: Advantage/disadvantage
order: Multiple same type do not stack; both cancel regardless of source count. Missing conditions remain unknown.
stackingCapsFloors: At most two dice for this policy

name: Resistance
order: General factor/rounding not specified; do not infer half.

name: Vulnerability
order: No general definition located; do not infer double.

name: Immunity
inputs: target-kind and effect eligibility, explicit immunity
order: Hull poison/radiation cannot harm it; psychic only if affects objects/machinery. Creature fear immunity does not imply psychic-damage immunity. General precedence with other modifiers requires review.

name: Equipment modifiers
inputs: active owned item instances, host/scope, usage
order: Only eligible source effects; do not grant carried items automatically. Signature Wargear maximum three active, switched during rest/downtime.

name: Armour modifiers
inputs: one explicit AC expression and penalties
order: Separate AC base from damage reduction/resistance and condition modifiers. Register profile derivations for explicit expressions.

name: Shield modifiers
order: Shield +2 and one hand explicit. Riot Shield subclass +1 while shield used now structured; shove advantage stays manual.

name: Resource maximums
order: Use exact feature maximum only; once-per-rest=1, PB-per-rest=PB. Do not impose maximum on Warp Pressure.

name: Resource recovery
order: Recover only explicitly matching rest/event; no recalculation/refresh recharge.
stackingCapsFloors: One event applied once is technical idempotency

name: Rest recovery
inputs: time/rest qualification, spent Hit Dice, food/water/safety
order: Short >=1h: spend HD and heal roll+Con. Long >=8h/6sleep: restore HP; regain up to half total HD min1; pressure0; exhaustion-1 with food/water/safe rest. Once/24h; no Corruption removal. Odd HD rounding unresolved.
stackingCapsFloors: Do not exceed spent HD; odd-half policy needs ruling

name: Level scaling
order: Use exact source thresholds, no extrapolation; levels1..20. Keep source occurrence identities.

name: Class progression
order: 12 class tables;45 subclass progressions. Selected subclass grants its rows, parent grants choice once. Upgrades still manual until replacement semantics mapped.

name: Psychic resource calculation
order: Gain1/2/3 plus1 empowered before resolving power/Perils; after power d20<=pressure;severityd20+pressure;31+ open. Rest0. Odd post-Perils rounding/floor unresolved.
stackingCapsFloors: No pressure cap; specific minimum cost1 only when stated

name: Vehicle calculations
order: Per hit sum components after resistance;DTfloor(DT/2) if Armour-Breaking;below0 else full. Driving Dex(Vehicles)+Handling; mounted attacks proficiency once. Hull damage does not also damage crew.
stackingCapsFloors: Per-mount/round limits and crew state required

name: Weapon and psychic save DC
order: Weapon8+PB+weapon ability;psychic8+PB+Int/Wis;grenade8+PB+Dex;mounted8+Dex+PB only if trained.

name: Bloodied
order: 2*current<=maximum. No effect by itself. Below-half features use strict <, not Bloodied.
